item.title: Works due to commence on Carrickmacross CCTV scheme in March
item.description: Works due to commence next month on the Carrickmacross CCTV scheme. The local authority said it's anticipated that enabling civil and electrical works will commence in March. The camera system is expected to be operational by late Q2 of this year. Cameras will be installed in 14 locations with 17 cameras around the town of Carrickmacross. item.title: Local world-renowned musician and presenter conferred with trad music award
item.description: A local world-renowned musician and Shannonside Northern Sound presenter has been conferred with an award in honour of his contribution to Irish trad music. The Heathery Breeze presenter Paddy Ryan received the Dr John Stafford award at the Elphin Community Centre last night. The award is conferred to those who provide outstanding service to Irish traditional music in Roscommon. item.title: Agri technology company to partner with Cavan grassland advisory business
item.description: Proveye, the Irish agri- and climate-technology company specialising in grassland measurement and analysis has announced a new commercial partnership with Cavan Grassland Consultancy Ltd (CGC). The partnership will deploy ProvGrass, a satellite-based platform, to dairy farms supported by CGC across the North Midlands. Under the agreement, Cavan Grassland Consultancy will integrate Proveye's satellite-based grass measurement and monitoring technology into its grass advisory services. Advertisemen
